name: usched
description: A calm course planner for USC students

scripts.dev: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/index.js --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "uv run python -m server.main" "node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js client --clearScreen false"
scripts.check: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run basedpyright && uv run pytest && npm run check -w client
scripts.fix: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . && npm run fix -w client
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && uv run uvicorn server.main:app --port 8000
scripts.api: uv run python -m server.openapi > client/.openapi.json && npx --yes openapi-typescript@7.13.0 client/.openapi.json -o client/src/api/schema.d.ts
